title: God’s Covenant with David

questions.question: Who did David tell about his desire to build a house for God?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:1 (ESV): "David said to Nathan the prophet, 'Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.'"

questions.question: What was God’s answer to David regarding building the temple?
options: You shall not build me a house to dwell in
Go and do all that is in your heart
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not build me a house to dwell in
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:4 (ESV): "Go and tell my servant David, 'Thus says the LORD: It is not you who shall build me a house to dwell in.'"

questions.question: Who did God say would build His house?
options: One of your sons who shall succeed you
questions.correctAnswer: One of your sons who shall succeed you
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:11-12 (ESV): "...I will raise up your offspring after you... He shall build a house for me..."

questions.question: What did God promise to establish forever?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:12 (ESV): "...and I will establish his throne forever."

questions.question: How did David respond to God’s message?
options: He went in and sat before the LORD and prayed
questions.correctAnswer: He went in and sat before the LORD and prayed
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:16 (ESV): "Then King David went in and sat before the LORD..."

questions.question: From where did God take David to be prince over Israel?
options: From the pasture, from following the sheep
questions.correctAnswer: From the pasture, from following the sheep
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:7 (ESV): "...I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel."

questions.question: What name did God say He would make for David?
options: A name like the name of the great ones of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: A name like the name of the great ones of the earth
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:8 (ESV): "...And I will make for you a name, like the name of the great ones of the earth."

questions.question: What did David ask God to do with the word He spoke concerning His servant?
options: Establish it forever and do as You have spoken
questions.correctAnswer: Establish it forever and do as You have spoken
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:23 (ESV): "...let the word that you have spoken... be established forever, and do as you have spoken."

questions.question: Why did God redeem Israel out of Egypt?
options: To make a people for himself
questions.correctAnswer: To make a people for himself
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:21 (ESV): "...whom God went to redeem to be his people..."

questions.question: What relationship did God say He would have with David's son?
options: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son
questions.correctAnswer: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:13 (ESV): "I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son..."

questions.question: Why did God say He has done all this greatness?
options: For your servant's sake and according to your own heart
questions.correctAnswer: For your servant's sake and according to your own heart
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:19 (ESV): "For your servant's sake, O LORD, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness..."

questions.question: What did God say He would not take away from David's son, as He took it from the one before him?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:13 (ESV): "...I will not take my steadfast love from him, as I took it from him who was before you."

questions.question: Who was the one "before" David referenced in the promise?
questions.explanation: Implicit reference to Saul. 1 Chronicles 17:13 says "him who was before you". Reference back to 1 Chronicles 10 confirms Saul.

questions.question: What phrase did David use to describe God’s uniqueness?
options: There is none like you, O LORD, and there is no God besides you
You are high and lifted up
questions.correctAnswer: There is none like you, O LORD, and there is no God besides you
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:20 (ESV): "There is none like you, O LORD, and there is no God besides you..."

questions.question: What did David say would happen to his house because God blessed it?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:27 (ESV): "...For what you, O LORD, have blessed is blessed forever."

key_verse_text: When your days are fulfilled to walk with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom. He shall build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.
